requirements.title: Answer quality for deployed prompt
requirements.summary: Requirement REQ-03 has INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE because KAN-217 was evaluated on staging with wrong commit 9c3e1aa, and KAN-29 evaluated prompt p6 instead of target deployed prompt p7.
requirements.rationale:
Requirement REQ-03 mandates an approved quality evaluation achieving at least 90% accuracy that matches deployed prompt p7 for target commit b7a91f2, service atlas-assistant, release R2.4 in production.

The available evidence records fail to cover the target scope:
1. Record KAN-217 (comment 11071) reports EVAL-61 scored 91.0% for prompt p7, but was executed on staging environment and commit 9c3e1aa, violating the rule that QA results must match target commit b7a91f2 and target environment production (staging approvals cannot approve production).
2. Record KAN-29 (comments 10131, 10136) reports EVAL-55 scored 96.2% on target commit b7a91f2 in production, but was configured and run with prompt bundle p6 instead of deployed prompt p7, violating the rule that prompt-quality evaluations must match the deployed prompt.
3. Developer assertions on KAN-228 (comment 11126) do not constitute proof of acceptance per assessment rules.

Because no applicable quality evaluation matches all target build criteria (commit b7a91f2, environment production, prompt p7), the requirement has INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

requirements.title: Rollback rehearsal
requirements.summary: Requirement REQ-09 is assessed as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE due to contradictory and unresolved rollback rehearsal results across linked evidence records.
requirements.rationale: The requirement mandates an approved rollback rehearsal that succeeds on the target release and production configuration. Two linked evidence records provide contradictory results for the target release/commit/service/environment: KAN-108 (RB-401) reports a successful rehearsal, while KAN-177 (KAN-177 / RB-402) reports a failure due to data loss. Per the assessment rules, for contradictory equally authoritative current records with no resolution, we must use insufficient evidence rather than file order. Therefore, the requirement cannot be assessed as PASS or FAIL and must be marked INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
